datetime(2026-01-01T00:05:00Z), "FIXTURE-UNSCOPED", "ANALYST", "synthetic", "SOURCE-A", "Network", 99, "LogonSuccess"
]
| where Timestamp >= Start and Timestamp < End
| where DeviceId in (DeviceScope)
| where Timestamp {TimeRange}
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, AccountName, AccountDomain, RemoteIP, LogonType, ReportId, ActionType
);
// Raw rows retain duplicates and missing keys for the coverage panel.
let Deduplicated = Raw | extend AccountName=tolower(AccountName), AccountDomain=tolower(AccountDomain) | distinct *;
let Scoped = materialize(
    Raw
    | where Timestamp >= Start and Timestamp < End
    | where DeviceId in (DeviceScope)
    | where isnotempty(AccountName) and isnotempty(AccountDomain)
        and isnotempty(RemoteIP) and isnotempty(LogonType) and isnotnull(ReportId)
    | extend UserKey=tolower(AccountName), DomainKey=tolower(AccountDomain)
    | project Timestamp, DeviceId, ReportId, ActionType, UserKey, DomainKey, RemoteIP, LogonType
    | distinct *
);
let Failures = Scoped | where ActionType == "LogonFailed"
    | project DeviceId, UserKey, DomainKey, RemoteIP, LogonType, FailureAt=Timestamp, FailureReportId=ReportId;
let Successes = Scoped | where ActionType == "LogonSuccess"
    | project DeviceId, UserKey, DomainKey, RemoteIP, LogonType, SuccessAt=Timestamp, SuccessReportId=ReportId;
let Candidates = (Successes
| join kind=inner (Failures) on DeviceId, UserKey, DomainKey, RemoteIP, LogonType
| where FailureAt >= SuccessAt - Window and FailureAt < SuccessAt
| summarize FailureCount=count(), FirstFailure=min(FailureAt), LastFailure=max(FailureAt)
    by DeviceId, UserKey, DomainKey, RemoteIP, LogonType, SuccessAt, SuccessReportId
| where FailureCount >= Threshold
| order by SuccessAt asc
);
Candidates
| project DeviceId, UserKey, DomainKey, RemoteIP, LogonType, SuccessAt, SuccessReportId
| join kind=inner (Scoped | project DeviceId, UserKey, DomainKey, RemoteIP, LogonType,
    EventAt=Timestamp, EventReportId=ReportId, ActionType) on DeviceId, UserKey, DomainKey, RemoteIP, LogonType
| where EventAt >= SuccessAt - Window and EventAt <= SuccessAt
| project SuccessAt, SuccessReportId, EventAt, EventReportId, DeviceId, DomainKey, UserKey, RemoteIP, LogonType, ActionType
| order by SuccessAt asc, EventAt asc, EventReportId asc

## Investigation and limitations

1. Inspect coverage, duplicates, missing keys, unknown actions and clipped lookbacks first.
2. Validate source/event identities, successful-logon meaning and benign explanations (stale credentials, operator retries or automation).
3. Correlate process and network context only within separately authorized asset/time scope. Retain exact query hashes and private evidence.
4. Record a supported triage decision before proposing response; this workbook creates no alerts and changes no systems.

The detector groups by device, domain, account, source IP and logon type. Distributed or rotating-source attempts may evade it. Missing fields and missing ingestion reduce coverage. Event identifiers and timestamps support investigation but do not prove authenticity. The context grid may repeat an event for overlapping candidate windows; count sequences separately from distinct events. Selecting a narrower display interval can clip a lookback further than the fixed Start marker indicates. Retain the full ten-minute authorized lookback when adjudicating a sequence.
